caption: The drawing consists of two orthographic views of a mechanical object, rendered in thin black lines on a beige background. The object features a large circular wheel, centrally mounted on a vertical axis, supported by a tall, hourglass-shaped pedestal that widens at the base. The wheel, visible in the left view, is subdivided into six equal segments by spoke-like lines, with two additional concentric circles marking its edge. The right view shows the object from the side, depicting the thickness of the wheel and details of its central mounting and support mechanism, along with dimensions for various segments, such as the diameter of the wheel and the height of the pedestal and base. The base is square with layered steps, and multiple banisters or supports connect the parts. Several dimensions are annotated in inches. The bottom right corner has a label with the name "James H. Lawson" and "Del. 7.3". The drawing does not use any shading or color aside from the black outlines against the plain background.
title: Lottery Wheel
